title: Estagiário jurídico
description:
Sobre a Reit
Fundada em 2007, a REIT iniciou suas atividades com foco em estruturação de operações financeiras direcionadas para o setor imobiliário, ampliando posteriormente sua atuação no setor do agronegócio. Desde 2011, atuamos na originação, estruturação e emissão de Certificados de Recebíveis Imobiliários e do Agronegócio (CRIs e CRAs ), onde nosso principal objetivo é fazer com que nossos clientes captem recursos no mercado de capitais, podendo desenvolver seus projetos, sejam eles empreendimentos imobiliários ou do agronegócio. Estrutura jurídica e backoffice próprios, com forte expertise em finanças imobiliárias e do agronegócio, garantindo qualidade na emissão, na gestão e monitoramento das operações. Mais de 3 bilhões em operações de crédito estruturado, sejam no formato de CCIs, CRIs ou CRAs.
Responsabilidades
Acompanhamento das etapas de estruturação de operações de securitização, incluindo emissões de CRI, CRA, CR e debêntures;
Auxílio na elaboração e revisão de minutas de contratos, notificações, comunicados a órgãos reguladores e demais documentos no âmbito de operações estruturadas;
Acompanhamento de processos de due diligence jurídica;
Levantamento e organização de documentos públicos junto a Cartórios de Registro de Imóveis, Cartórios de Notas e Juntas Comerciais, inclusive para formalização e averbação de garantias;
Acompanhamento de registros e protocolos junto a órgãos reguladores e entidades de mercado, incluindo CVM e B3;
Suporte na fasede monitoramento pós-emissão, com acompanhamento do cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias e contratuais;
Acompanhamento de processos judiciais e administrativos;
Participação emassembleias de titulares de certificados de recebíveis e de debenturistas; e
Análise e organização de documentação contratual no âmbito de operações estruturadas. Qualificações
Estar cursando superior em Direito (5° período em diante);
Desejável conhecimento no Mercado de Capitais.
Informações
Bolsa auxílio;
Benefícios: VT + VR + Wellhub + Seguro de Vida
Local de trabalho: Ipanema / RJ;
Modalidade: Presencial;
Horário Flexível: 6 horas/dia.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;

- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;

- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Técnico de implantação
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global fundada em 2001, nos arredores de Chicago, especializada na integração de sistemas de segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety. Hoje contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo, sempre com o propósito de oferecer o melhor serviço para nossos clientes e desenvolver grandes profissionais.
Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (Pc D) .
Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico de Implantação I para atuar na área de Operações, sendo responsável pela instalação, montagem e implantação de sistemas eletrônicos em campo, garantindo a correta execução dos projetos conforme os padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa.
Principais responsabilidades
• Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem
• Instalação e conexão de dispositivos de BMS, Segurança Eletrônica e SDAI (câmeras, sensores, detectores, leitores, atuadores, entre outros)
• Montagem e organização de racks e infraestrutura de cabeamento estruturado (RCE)
• Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone e terminais elétricos)
• Instalação de patch panels, switches e interligação de dispositivos de rede
• Atuação em campo, incluindo trabalho em altura (NR35)
• Reporte das atividades executadas para liderança e time de projetos
• Cumprimento de normas de qualidade, segurança da informação e procedimentos internos
• Disponibilidade para viagens conforme necessidade dos projetos
Requisitos
• Curso técnico em Eletrônica, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente)
• Conhecimento em cabeamento estruturado e instalação de sistemas eletrônicos
• Conhecimento em Pacote Office
• Facilidade com tecnologia e dispositivos móveis
• Vivência com manuseio de ferramentas elétricas

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Ecu calibration engineer - relocation to spain
description:
Boost your career in the automotive sector with ALTEN Spain
Take part in innovative automotive projects in Spain, contributing your expertise in ECU calibration, engine systems, and vehicle electronics.
At ALTEN, we believe that people are the true driving force behind our projects. That’s why, if you have at least 3–5 years of experience in automotive calibration—working with ECUs, engine systems, or validation—we want to support your professional growth, enhance your talent, and provide an environment where you feel valued from day one.
Would you like to be part of the future of mobility? Keep reading
Your mission
Based in Spain, you will contribute to key automotive projects by ensuring the correct calibration, validation, and performance of electronic control units (ECUs), guaranteeing the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and compliance.
Key responsibilities
Perform ECU calibration by loading and applying calibration files (.hex,.a2l,.dcm) in vehicles or test benches
Analyze and adjust key calibration variables related to engine management and software control
Execute validation tests to ensure compliance with system requirements
Use diagnostic and calibration tools such as INCA, CANalyzer, Diag RA, HIL benches, or dynamometers
Prepare and manage ECU software (flashing, assembly, version control, and traceability)
Collaborate with hardware, software, and validation teams for seamless system integration
Identify, analyze, and resolve technical issues during calibration processes
Prepare technical documentation and reports ensuring quality standards compliance

title: English teacher

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: P&c insurance claims expert
description:

POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:
As a P& C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our
customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes
through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.
Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of Saa S solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.
This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.

DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Customer Relationship Management Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted
advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on
expectations and needs.
Proactive Engagement Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning
sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose
proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.
Performance Monitoring Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the
product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and
intervene early when needed.
Product Enhancements Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product
development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the
customer.
Renewals and Upselling Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.
Customer Training Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.
Internal Collaboration Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.
JOB SKILLS:
Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global
environment.
Must Haves: Insurance Expertise Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value
Language Skills
This role requires tri-lingual language skills: Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.
Nice to Haves: Customer Focus and Engagement You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand
their needs and exceed their expectations.
Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business
objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling
and analytical insights.
Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant Saa S tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.
Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front).
Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions.
Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services.
Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer).
Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.

Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.
Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

title: Técnico de serviços em maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.
A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:
Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.
Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:
• Radares
• ECDIS
• Satcoms
• Rádios HF e VHF
• GPS
• Girobússola
• Pilotos automáticos
• Sirenes
Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:
• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
• Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.
• Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.
Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Partner success manager
description:
Sobre a vaga
O(a) Partner Success Manager atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e organizações parceiras de serviços para assegurar resultados de alta qualidade. Trata-se de uma excelente oportunidade para ajudar a definir e expandir uma função que impacta diretamente o desempenho das entregas, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve a capacidade de longo prazo dos parceiros.

• Identificar riscos de forma proativa, reduzir fricções e gerenciar escalonamentos, facilitando planos de recuperação (“path to green”) e engajando as partes envolvidas para resolução de problemas.
• Garantir que os escalonamentos sejam monitorados, tratados com urgência e reportados de forma adequada.
• Colaborar com a área de Enablement para avaliar a prontidão e o alinhamento dos parceiros.

• Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Delivery, Suporte, Produto e Cloud para otimizar o suporte às implementações.
• Capturar e reportar resultados de entrega, tendências de escalonamento e indicadores de prontidão.
• Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de playbooks, procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) e frameworks de sucesso de parceiros.
Qualificações essenciais
• Mais de 2 anos de experiência em suporte à entrega, operações com parceiros, customer success, coordenação de projetos ou áreas correlatas.
• Forte organização e atenção aos detalhes.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
• Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes multifuncionais.
Desejáveis
• Experiência com ferramentas de acompanhamento de projetos ou tickets (ex.: Jira, Service Now, Zendesk).

• Proficiência em idiomas conforme a região (ver variações regionais).

title: Ai solutions lead
description:
Sobre a Hexa
A Hexa nasce com a ambição de se tornar uma das principais referências em inteligência artificial no Brasil. Atuamos na construção de soluções aplicadas que combinam estratégia, arquitetura, tecnologia e execução para gerar valor real aos clientes.
Nosso trabalho começa com entendimento profundo do contexto de cada empresa. Por meio do nosso Diagnóstico Vivo, analisamos cinco dimensões centrais — processos, dados, sistemas, resultados e governança — para identificar oportunidades e desenhar soluções integradas que façam sentido dentro do ecossistema do cliente.
Não buscamos criar iniciativas isoladas de IA. Nosso foco é estruturar soluções conectadas ao negócio, aos sistemas existentes e à operação, com visão de longo prazo, aplicabilidade prática e impacto mensurável.
A oportunidade
Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como referência técnica em soluções de IA dentro da Hexa.
Essa pessoa terá papel relevante no desenho das soluções que levamos aos clientes, ajudando a transformar contexto de negócio em arquitetura, decisão técnica e implementação. Procuramos alguém com boa profundidade técnica, perfil hands-on e capacidade de participar ativamente da construção, validação e evolução das soluções na prática.
Mais do que alguém que domina ferramentas, queremos uma pessoa com bom julgamento técnico. Alguém que saiba avaliar quando usar LLMs, quando usar agentes, quando optar por automações mais determinísticas, quando aplicar técnicas tradicionais de machine learning e, principalmente, como integrar essas abordagens em soluções coerentes, sustentáveis e orientadas a valor.
Como a Hexa está em fase de construção, esta é uma posição para quem quer ter impacto real, proximidade com liderança e espaço para contribuir com a forma como a empresa desenha e entrega soluções de IA aplicada.
Responsabilidades
Participar do desenho técnico de soluções de IA para clientes, do diagnóstico à definição da arquitetura.
Atuar como referência técnica em IA aplicada dentro da Hexa, contribuindo com decisões técnicas de forma pragmática.
Traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções viáveis, integradas e orientadas a resultado.
Definir, junto ao time, a melhor abordagem para cada contexto, incluindo LLMs, agentes, workflows, automação, ML clássico, visão computacional ou combinações dessas frentes.
Apoiar processos de discovery, pré-venda e desenho de propostas técnicas.
Contribuir para padrões de desenvolvimento, validação, avaliação, observabilidade, segurança e evolução das soluções.
Trabalhar na construção de soluções agênticas e ecossistemas integrados aos dados, sistemas e processos dos clientes.
Apoiar a criação de playbooks, repertório técnico e boas práticas internas.
Contribuir para a consolidação da proposta de valor e do posicionamento técnico da Hexa no mercado.
O que buscamos
Experiência real com arquitetura e entrega de soluções de IA em produção.
Base sólida em arquitetura de software, integrações, APIs e desenho de soluções.
Domínio prático de aplicações com LLMs.
Experiência com agentes, tool calling, workflows e orquestração de soluções de IA.
Entendimento de prompt engineering, context engineering, avaliação de qualidade, guardrails e observabilidade.
Boa capacidade de análise de negócio e de tradução entre contexto executivo e decisão técnica.
Conhecimento consistente de dados, estrutura de dados e fundamentos de machine learning.
Familiaridade com visão computacional será considerada um diferencial.
Curiosidade genuína sobre o ecossistema atual de IA, ferramentas emergentes e novas formas de construir soluções.
Autonomia, senso de dono, maturidade para priorizar e forte accountability.
Interesse em atuar em uma empresa pequena, em construção, com proximidade com liderança e clientes.
Perfil ideal
Procuramos uma pessoa que reúna três características ao mesmo tempo:
profundidade técnica para tomar boas decisões;
profundidade técnica para contribuir com boas decisões;
capacidade prática para construir e validar soluções;
maturidade para atuar com autonomia em um ambiente de alta responsabilidade. Não buscamos um perfil apenas acadêmico, nem alguém focado exclusivamente em pesquisa. Também não buscamos uma liderança distante da execução. Esta posição exige presença técnica real, boa comunicação, visão arquitetural e conforto para operar em contexto de ambiguidade e crescimento.
Diferenciais
Experiência anterior em consultoria, boutique de tecnologia, startup ou ambiente de construção.
Vivência com projetos B2 B complexos e integração com ambientes corporativos.
Experiência com soluções agênticas, agentes autônomos, multiagentes ou arquiteturas orientadas a ferramentas.
Familiaridade com ambientes cloud e decisões de arquitetura distribuída.
Capacidade de equilibrar profundidade técnica com pragmatismo de negócio e clareza executiva.
Modelo de contratação
Contratação no modelo PJ.
Posição com senioridade entre pleno e sênior, com expectativa de forte participação técnica e capacidade de execução.
Atuação em ambiente de alta autonomia, baixa burocracia e proximidade com decisões estratégicas.
O que a pessoa encontrará na Hexa
Espaço real para construir.
Proximidade com clientes, liderança e decisões estratégicas.
Ambiente de alta autonomia, baixa burocracia e forte senso de responsabilidade.
Oportunidade de participar da construção de uma empresa de IA desde seus fundamentos.
Contexto ideal para quem quer combinar profundidade técnica, impacto prático e crescimento acelerado.
Encerramento
Se você quer atuar em uma posição com impacto real, profundidade técnica e protagonismo na construção de soluções de IA aplicadas, a Hexa pode ser o lugar certo para você.
Buscamos alguém que queira ajudar a construir não apenas projetos, mas uma forma consistente, sofisticada e prática de aplicar inteligência artificial para transformar negócios.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

Atividades

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Equity to feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

Overview

Descrição da vaga. Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

  • Atuar no acompanhamento e manutenção de turbinas (a gás ou vapor), incluindo análise de desempenho, falhas recorrentes e planos de melhoria contínua.
  • Utilizar e manter atualizados sistemas de gestão da manutenção (CMMS/ERP), assegurando a correta abertura, execução e encerramento de ordens de serviço, históricos de falhas e controle de backlog.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar KPIs de Manutenção, tais como disponibilidade física, MTBF, MTTR, aderência ao plano de manutenção, custos e índice de falhas críticas.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração e revisão dos planos de manutenção, estratégias de confiabilidade e análises de criticidade dos ativos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Apoiar investigações de falhas, análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Gerenciar contratos e atividades de empresas terceirizadas, garantindo conformidade técnica, prazos, qualidade e segurança dos serviços executados.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, promovendo treinamentos, padronização de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica ou graduação completa em Mecânica, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória: experiência comprovada em supervisão de manutenção mecânica em ambiente offshore.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, guindastes e equipamentos rotativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em sistemas de gestão da manutenção e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Experiência com equipamentos de perfuração e/ou turbinas (gás ou vapor) será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas, boas práticas de manutenção e requisitos regulatórios do setor de óleo e gás.

Informações adicionais

  • Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura.
  • Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas.
  • Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.
  • Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o gestor da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.
  • Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista. Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, então não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo! Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

Sobre a PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único. Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório sem paredes que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description:
Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.

Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation

Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
  • Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs.
  • Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required.
  • Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required.
  • Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
  • Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
  • Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
  • Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
  • Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
  • Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
  • Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
  • Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
  • Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
  • Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).
  • Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.G., SIMOPS, ALARP).
  • Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
  • Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
  • A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil.
